datasets.title: Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of): JIAF Humanitarian Needs People in Need and Severity
datasets.description: This dataset contains the overall people in need and intersectoral severity by disaggregation level which Includes administrative divisions and population groups, depending on each country's decision. The dataset is produced by the United Nations for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) in collaboration with humanitarian partners using the Joint Intersectoral Analysis Framework(JIAF).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ven-jiaf-humanitarian-needs-pin-and-severity]

entity.name: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)

lineage.description: Humanitarian partners conducted sectoral needs assessments across Venezuela's administrative divisions using the Joint Intersectoral Analysis Framework (JIAF) methodology. OCHA integrated these sectoral inputs (food security, nutrition, health, WASH, shelter, education, protection) to produce intersectoral severity scores and final people in need estimates at admin 1 and admin 2 levels.

sources.name: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)
sources.description: Coordinating organization that compiled humanitarian needs assessments from partner organizations using the JIAF methodology to produce people in need and severity estimates.

sources.name: Humanitarian partners
sources.description: Multiple humanitarian organizations contributing sectoral needs data (food security, nutrition, health, WASH, shelter, education, protection) that were integrated into the overall people in need assessment.
